content: If the value DCM_E_FORCE_RCRRP is returned from an oper- ation using Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm shall invoke the transmit request for RCR-RP (NRC 0x78 transmission) and the Dcm shall not realize further invocation of the opera- tion till RCR-RP is transmitted.

If the value DCM_E_FORCE_RCRRP is returned from an oper- ation using Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm shall invoke the transmit request for RCR-RP (NRC 0x78 transmission) and the Dcm shall not realize further invocation of the opera- tion till RCR-RP is transmitted.
